model: fixed nonnegative incoherent 16-to-4 intensity classifier; 48 directional couplers; exactly four positive gains plus four electronic offsets
scope: Prospective new split after exploratory MNIST use. Numerical engineering evidence; no independently unseen dataset or fabricated device claim. Stage-specific source commitments required before physical/layout validation.
target_basis: Fixed before this run from guide's prior exploratory MNIST accuracy; not retrospectively chosen from validation

resource_limits.gpu: queue only; no GPU required for F1/F2

heldout_policy.prior_use: MNIST was used for exploratory fitting and evaluation. Official test already explored; exclude it from this run.
heldout_policy.split: stratified 60/20/20 train/validation/test; separate 20% of training as calibration
heldout_policy.seal: salted SHA256 outside repository; no test labels read outside custodian; public test features not accessed during training
heldout_policy.custody_limit: Same host and public source labels allow recovery; procedural seal, not independent security or independent external custody
heldout_policy.one_shot: Final Blender predictions before reveal, after F0/F3/F5 dependencies satisfied. Any later change after reveal requires a new dataset/protocol, never reuse test for selection.

noise_fine_tune.nominal_tree: keep structural zero per column; global scaling only

tolerances.distribution: Gaussian relative kappa as exploratory model; clip negative multipliers to zero; not a supplier tolerance distribution

F5.profile: supplier confirmed; modes and access-bend coupling included

design_clarifications: N3 normalized class prototypes shifted by common column minimum and one global scale preserves argmax and leaves at most three useful leaves; original means retained for presentation.
No per-column rescaling: it changes the classifier.
N4 uniform four detector leaves without discard uses a different leaf mapping.
F4 final sealed benchmark deferred until F5 corrections stop, resolving guide conflict between one-shot test and repeating F3/F4 after corrections.
F0 response must replace provisional kappa/profile and DRC before manufacturing readiness.
N2 may be provisional kappa precompensation only; not measured process correction.
